run_tf_predictor: run the TableFormer predictor on a page input JSON and table bboxes JSON file via CLI
test_tf_predictor: test the TableFormer predictor with sample IOCR page data and table bounding boxes
init: initialize the TableFormer predictor by downloading model artifacts from Hugging Face Hub
combine_checkpoint: combine split checkpoint files into a single checkpoint file for the TableFormer model
multi_table_predict: predict table cell structures and text content for multiple tables on a page
